metadata.description:
I, Maki Maehara, am a class loner. My first friend ever is Umi Asanagi. She is always at the center of the social circle, the girl the guys secretly whisper is the "second cutest in the class." I thought a background character like me lived in a completely different world from her, but it turns out she's a huge fan of B-movies!? After becoming friends through a twist of fate, Asanagi secretly comes to hang out at my house every Friday after school. Movies, games, manga, we have a great time together sharing the exact same hobbies. "Hey, Maehara, look! I'll let you sit right here as a special treat." "That's my bed to begin with..." "Just for today, it's my bed. Come on, get over here." Aren't you a little too close, Asanagi?
___

metadata.title: Bocchi the Rock!
metadata.description: Hitori Gotoh chơi guitar từ khi mới học trung học vì giấc mơ tham gia ban nhạc và trở nên nổi tiếng. Nhưng trớ trêu do tính cách hướng nội, rối loạn giao tiếp xã hội của mình mà cô không có một người bạn nào trong suốt những năm tháng cấp hai lên cấp ba. Và rồi, ước mơ đó bắt đầu có cơ sở trở thành hiện thực khi cô gặp Nijika Ijichi, một tay trống đang gấp rút tìm kiếm một người biết chơi guitar cho ban nhạc của mình.

alternativeTitles: ปิ๊งรักรุ่นพี่สายดุ

Kannawa-senpai is considered many things, but smooth is definitely not one of them. Then she meets Kamegawa, her new Kouhai. He's cute, a little nerdy, and easy to talk to. How will this awkward Senpai be able to handle these new feelings!?

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

metadata.description:
Oneshot promoting the first volume of the Light Novel "Alya, Who Sits Next to Me, Sometimes Whispers Sweet Nothings in Russian". Popularity may result in a serialization!  
  
Follow the story of the ice-cold perfect beauty, the half-Russian Alisa "Alya" Mikhailovna Kujo, and your average high school underachiever, Masachika Kuze. She has a cold exterior, but speaks her love in a language she thinks nobody understands… Little does she know that he understands her just fine! Enjoy the silly slice-of-life romance between Snow Princess and Mr. Worldwide!
